title: 日神的低语
text:
另一座祭坛，烧得正旺。一枚{item:charm_sun}摆在火边。

拿了放进包里，{b}不会自动换神{/b}：点它说明窗下的「奉为主信仰」，你信的才换成{faith:sun}，{faith:brute}那几行字会变灰（休眠），顶端栏的徽记换成{faith:sun}的。{b}经验值是这一局一池，换神不会丢{/b}。火边的余烬也给了你一大块经验值，够你升到第二阶。

想换回来：{b}右键{/b}{item:charm_brute}，同样点「奉为主信仰」。换神没有代价。

texts.en:
Another altar, burning hot. A {item:charm_sun} lies by the fire.

Putting it in your bag {b}doesn't switch gods by itself{/b}: press Make main faith under its tooltip and you follow {faith:sun} instead. The lines tied to {faith:brute} turn grey (dormant), and the emblem in the top bar becomes the one for {faith:sun}. {b}XP is one pool for the run. You lose nothing.{/b} The embers by the fire also give you a large chunk of XP, enough to reach Rank two.

Want to switch back? {b}Right-click{/b} the {item:charm_brute} and press Make main faith again. Switching gods costs nothing.

outcomes.text: 两枚护符，两位神。奉哪位，你自己点。

texts.en: Two charms, two gods. You choose which one to follow.
